title: What happens if you fall for the Microsoft Tech Support scam
description: Recording of a phone call from a scammer who claims to be a Microsoft representative.  The scammers call everyone, and their ultimate goal is to have you pay. If you fall for their scam, but do not want to pay, then they will immobilize your Windows-installation.  The computer I let them into was set up specifically for this purpose. It was safe to let them in, and I had everything under control the whole time.  This was a fresh Windows 10 installation that did not have any problems, nor any hackers. Everything they tell me in the phone call is a lie constructed to convince me to first give them control, and then to pay them. If I do not pay them they lock down the computer and attempt to force me to pay them.
